target_name: Consolidated Net Durable Intangible Capital with Cash-Earnings Floor
rationale: This is a near-duplicate of the archived gen-7 "Net Durable Intangible Capital Behind a Cash-Earnings Floor," differing only in swapping the stock of purchased intangibles for its five-year flow (a change already tested in the gen-7 build-minus-buy signal), so it is a mechanical recombination of validated parts rather than a new economic mechanism, and the arbitrary dollar-for-dollar netting of dlc against R&D remains unmotivated.

target_name: Research Intensity with Cash-Denominated Deal Premium
rationale: The diagnosis (zero FMB slope from compression near zero) is sensible and the pairing is new, but the second leg is numerically fragile because TS_SUM(oancf,5) can be negative or near-offsetting, making the ratio non-monotone and capable of ranking distressed cash-burners at the top — precisely the population the R&D-intensity leg selects — so the conjunction may amplify rather than fix the leg's defect.

target_name: Acquisitive Expansion Without an Earnings Floor
rationale: The joint-failure corner (heavy five-year intangible build plus no cash-earnings floor) is a genuinely different quadrant from the archived gen-6 "Recent Deal Flow" positive-corner signal and the sign is internally consistent with the MIN construction, though both legs individually are close to the well-known asset-growth and profitability anomalies, so incremental content over a simple asset-growth/profitability double sort is uncertain.

Vintage of the knowledge stock is the one dimension the archive has never measured and the ratio is cleanly self-normalising, but the reviewer should note it is close to the published R&D-increase anomaly (Eberhart–Maxwell–Siddique) and that 0.05 coverage plus a mechanically bounded denominator will limit dispersion, so treat a strong result with appropriate caution.

target_name: Acquisitiveness Penalty Alone at Full Coverage
rationale: This is the archived gen-6 "Recent Deal Flow Versus Legacy Intangible Stock" with the oancf floor swapped for the ib+dp floor already validated in gen-6, i.e. two archived components joined by a substitution whose effect is known, so the ablation is only weakly informative and near-certain to reproduce prior results.

target_name: Worst-Year Cash Earnings on Penalized Capital at Full Coverage
rationale: A one-input proxy swap (oancf → ib+dp) on the archived gen-6 "Worst-Year Pre-Research Return on Penalized Capital" is exactly the cosmetic coverage-extension variant the objective warns against, and the double-charging of goodwill in the denominator is an arbitrary weighting inherited unexamined from the parent.
